text:
kevin (Eng Manager): Quick check  we're moving Sam from L2 -> L3, planned effective 2026-06-01. We want a $$ bump and one-time equity refresh. Do we need comp committee? Any special docs?

nina (People Ops): Congrats! If the total base increase is <= 8% and stays inside the L3 band, no comp committee. Equity refreshs are submitted separately via Equity Grant Request; small refreshes typically don't need committee either but check thresholds.

olga (Compensation): Add: if the bump + equity moves them above the band midpoint or base increase >8% --> comp committee. Attach a short promo note, updated role summary, and comparable peer comp examples.

kevin (Eng Manager): Got it. We also want to change the manager for Sam at the same time. Any HR implications?

julia (HRBP): Changing manager+promotion on same date is OK. Please note both changes in the Comp Change Request and update org chart in the form. If it's a lateral move across teams we may want a handoff note and manager approvals from both managers.

maria (People Ops): Also flag for onboarding checks: update reporting line in HRIS and Slack profile on the effective date so access and approvals flow correctly.

payroll-bot: FYI payroll cutoff for June effective changes is 2026-05-20 17:00 PDT. Submissions after that will apply to the following payroll. See https://intra.redwood/payroll

tara (Finance): From finance: include cost center and budget impact. If combined comp + equity > $10k annually, we need a quarterly forecast update. Put the effective date clearly so headcount spend is updated.

kevin (Eng Manager): Thanks. For equity grant docs, what level of detail is expected in the "impact" section?

olga (Compensation): Short is fine: 2-3 bullets: scope increase, measurable outcomes, leadership/mentorship examples. Add expected retention rationale for refresh. No need for a long narrative.

sam (IC): Quick question: will this change my annual bonus % or vesting schedule?

julia (HRBP): Bonus target may change if role & level change; we'll prorate from the effective date. Vesting schedule for new refresh starts from grant date; existing awards unaffected. We'll confirm in your award letter.

kevin (Eng Manager): Any sample sentence for manager justification? Want to keep it tight.

maria (People Ops): Try: "Recommendation: Promote Sam to L3 effective 2026-06-01 based on ownership of Project Z (launched 2026-03), increased code review capacity (+30%), and mentorship of two new hires. Requesting +7% base and one-time refresh to align with market median."

kevin (Eng Manager): Perfect. I'll prepare the Comp Change Request and Equity Grant Request, attach the short promo note and org-chart change. Tagging @olga for review before submission.

nina (People Ops): Happy to review the draft here or DM. If you plan to submit after payroll cutoff, set the effective date accordingly and note the payroll timing in the request. Good luck! :slightly_smiling_face:
